reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many different callees including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these callees have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow processing requests but the delay is before their processing starts.
Frontend's own p95 latency is very high at 1504.14ms, confirming it is slow while processing requests.
CPU usage of frontend is 0.007 cores out of 0.010 cores limit, which is 75% of its CPU limit, indicating it is CPU throttled and likely resource exhausted.
No other service shows multiple slow inbound edges or high server-side latency, so frontend is the root cause.
The fault propagates downstream from frontend to all its callees, impacting the critical business path services cartservice, checkoutservice, productcatalogservice, and others.
